onboarding.step1Body: Understand your desktop usage habits and build a healthier digital lifestyle.
onboarding.step2Body: By default, this app records window titles (e.g. email subjects, file names). You can enable Privacy Mode in Settings to only log app names. All data is stored locally on your machine and is never uploaded to any server.
onboarding.step3Body: Start tracking your screen time now and see where your time goes. Enjoy!
